novelty.justification: The novelty route is a mechanism and measurement hypothesis: the claim says redundant steps occur when an intermediate value is "already linearly decodable from hidden states before it is re-verbalized," and proposes this as a distinct internal-recomputation criterion rather than generic CoT verbosity. Searches using "chain of thought hidden state redundant recomputation," "linearly decodable intermediate results CoT," and "interpretability guided reasoning early exit" identify TrimR (2025) and Unveiling the Entropy Dynamics of Chain-of-Thought Reasoning (2026) as close work on online redundancy detection, while Interpreting the Latent Structure of Operator Precedence in Language Models (2025) already traces intermediate arithmetic results in residual streams. Connecting those established directions into an online "already-known" detector is a substantive natural extension and new operationalization, but not a wholly new core paradigm: prior work supplies both latent intermediate-value decoding and training-free redundancy-triggered inference control, while the specific relationship between prior decodability and later re-derivation appears distinct.
